_comment: Reference architecture dimensions for Qwen3.8-27B (qwen3_5 / Gated-DeltaNet hybrid),
reconstructed from anemll-forge source so the KVA prototype and its shape tests can run
without the real checkpoint present. These are a convenience fixture, NOT an authoritative
copy of the upstream config.json. At runtime, kva_qwen38.py reads the real text_config from
a checkpoint directory when --model is given and prefers those values.
hidden_size 5120, num_hidden_layers 64, MLP 17408, 24 q / 4 kv heads, head_dim 256,
attention layers 3,7,..,63 (interval 4, 16 layers; other 48 are linear_attention)
rope partial_rotary_factor / rope_theta below are typical qwen3_5 values used only for the
reference RoPE table; the real values come from the checkpoint when --model is provided.
